row_semantics: Each row represents a specific Direction Light status monitoring request for either the left or right front turn signal.

column_semantics.Row Header: Service interface name and instance ID for the direction light status request.
column_semantics.Consumption: Indicates whether the service is consumed (e.g., via SOA, ICB, LHZCU).
column_semantics.LHZCU: Local Host Control Unit interface usage.
column_semantics.Network Status: Status of network communication related to the service.

core_entities.name: DirectionLight
core_entities.description: Function related to the control and monitoring of direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightStatus
core_entities.description: Service interface used to subscribe to and retrieve the status of direction lights.

core_entities.name: SOA
core_entities.description: Service-Oriented Architecture interface for service communication.

core_entities.name: ICB
core_entities.description: Internal Communication Bus interface for internal system communication.

core_entities.name: LHZCU
core_entities.description: Local Host Control Unit responsible for local control and monitoring tasks.

core_conditions.name: InstanceID
core_conditions.description: Unique identifier for each instance of the direction light status request. Different IDs are used for left and right turn signals.

core_conditions.name: Parameter Name
core_conditions.description: Name of the parameter being monitored, which is 'DirectionLightSta' in this case.

core_conditions.name: Status Values
core_conditions.description: Possible states of the direction light: OFF (0x0), ON (0x1), Unknown (0x2).

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightStatus
core_outputs.description: The current status of the direction light as returned by the service interface.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and interfaces for subscribing to the status of front left and right turn signals in a vehicle's direction light system. It specifies how the system consumes the service via different communication interfaces and what the expected status values are.
uncertain_points: The exact meaning of the 'Network Status' column is not explicitly defined in the table.
The purpose of the 'Consumption' column beyond indicating interface usage is not clarified.
